name: knowledge-handover
description: Interview someone about how they really do their work and turn it into a Knowledge Pack: one zip with a browser walkthrough, their real screenshots or photos, and a file any AI can teach from. For new-hire manuals, stand-ins, team SOPs, know-how only one person has, and handovers.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your know-how into a guide anyone can learn from
interface.longDescription:
Your know-how, ready to pass on.

Knowledge Handover interviews the person who does the work, mostly through tappable choices, and captures how the work really happens and why: steps, exceptions, the giver's own screenshots or on-site photos, and, when the work is changing hands, pending work and accounts to transfer.

The result is one Knowledge Pack for a new hire, a stand-in, a teammate or a successor: START-HERE.html opens in any browser with step-by-step walkthroughs, and PACK-FOR-AI.md lets any AI teach the receiver. Every item is marked Confirmed, Needs confirmation or Open question, so nobody mistakes a guess for a rule. No server and no account: packs are files you keep.
defaultPrompt: Help me write a manual of my job for new staff.
Help me hand over my work before I leave.
Teach me from this knowledge pack.
